GRC.name: governed representation correction
GRC.rule: for a member listed in a sealed governed correction record, the corrected field is taken from projection V5 (which must equal the record's projected `after` token byte-for-byte) and the channel that reads it is re-executed with the frozen predicate
never: evidence or descriptor text reaching a predicate

WG.name: whole-garment regional fit (successor input contract)
WG.regional_keys_basis: Vision placement authority: Dress / Jumpsuit fit is emitted upper / lower (frozen Vision schema — Fit Upper/Lower split; controller byRegion = Dress/Jumpsuit fabric_behavior / fit). A byRegion form on any other key is carried by projection V5 but not consumed here (its recorded scalar keeps governing, as before).
WG.fit_evidence: every observed fit value of the one garment: the recorded scalar value (when one exists) and each regional value; region identity is location / provenance only
WG.reading: each value is presented, alone, as the garment's fit to the FROZEN silhouette predicate (with the frozen morphology / ladder / Q1 / Q3 order and the V2 O2 domain guard); the frozen verdicts are then read per WG-3 / WG-4: any TRUE → the channel is TRUE, located in the region(s) where observed; every required value observed and every verdict FALSE → FALSE; otherwise UNRESOLVED (the frozen unresolved verdict is carried)
WG.missing_region: a required region absent from the regional form → that region is presented as observed-without-value (the frozen predicate's own SIL-STATE outcome); the channel can then never read FALSE
WG.flare_contrast_scope: the frozen CEO §4.1 flare statement reads the upper-LEG fit with lower-leg geometry; on a one-piece the leg is realised by the lower region, so the upper (bodice) region is read by the frozen ladder only (V2.3.83 sealed WG-FIT design, authorized by D-83-2). No corpus unit is affected (no Flared jumpsuit exists).
WG.output: ONE garment-level silhouette verdict { v, rule, why, carrier: 'fit', strong, regional_evidence[] }; rule = the distinct frozen rule ids that decided, joined with '+' (the frozen composition convention of evaluator_v2_3_2 resolveMaterial); regional_evidence = [{ region, value, v, rule }] — metadata only
never: an either-region / both-region / priority / dominant / majority rule

MC1.name: Calf / Ankle mechanical closure
MC1.rule: for the listed keys, a recorded length token in the approved map is presented to the frozen proportion predicate in the frozen envelope spelling of the same zone; the frozen prop() decides
never: a changed meaning of Calf / Ankle

reproduction_guard: a channel is re-executed for a member only after the frozen predicate REPRODUCES the member's frozen historical verdict from the historical token set (V2 rule, extended to construction and proportion); otherwise ReproductionError (fail closed)
direction: member Direction = frozen direction() over the Direction-path verdicts (re-executed where a rule applied, otherwise the frozen verdict); unit Direction = frozen Step 2 unit aggregation (single garment / §7 pair rule) — unchanged
output_member_extra_fields: direction_path (only where the Direction-path verdict differs from the carried channel object, e.g. an existing OSF-7 overlay object)
not_responsibilities: new Atomic / Vision field / Departure family / vocabulary / enum
REF- or category-specific branching beyond the governed regional-key basis above
